facts.text: Bahari Nuru Trust commissioned her ngoma suite Pwani Mabawa, later shown at Mkunazini Dance House.
Her acclaimed masterclass Hatua za Taarab is hosted by Bahari Nuru Trust and funded through Mizani Stage Prize.
She sits, widely respected, on the Kilimani Dance Jury, convened by Unguja Arts Assembly alongside scholar Salma Hamadi.
Mchikichi Fellowship and Pemba Movement Lab jointly run her celebrated training project Visiwa Hatua in Stone Town.
She returns yearly to Jambiani Ukili Circle, a series programmed by Mnazi Shore Collective at Baraza Pavilion.
